videos.script: Every time an item changes, DynamoDB can write down what changed. {{stream}} That list is a stream. It holds each change once, in order for each item, for twenty-four hours. Then it is gone. {{records}} Something outside the table reads it and acts. Here it keeps a running total of what each Quitanda customer has spent. {{consumer}} You will run that consumer twice and see it count nothing new. Then you will run a careless one, and watch every total double. {{duplicates}} The stream never repeated a record. The reading did. A Lambda function that fails halfway through a batch does exactly the same, every time it is retried. {{retry}} And you will meet the items that delete themselves, and the other road out of a table, into Kinesis. moto runs neither, and the lesson says so. {{ttl}}
